_comment: Examples under datrix/examples/ that the REAL generation pipeline cannot build today.
This is a DELIBERATELY MAINTAINED SCOPE BOUNDARY, not an auto-heal: it converts a genuine,
pre-existing generation FAILURE into a loudly-reported skip in the reference-example parity
gate (datrix/scripts/test/reference-example-parity-gate.ps1). It never hides output drift --
a listed (example, language) pair that does generate is still hash-compared against its baseline.
KEY FORMAT (language sweep): a bare example_id applies to every registered
language the gate sweeps -- for a failure at config-resolution/deployment-plan-building time,
before any language-specific codegen stage runs (the original two entries below). An
'example_id::language' key applies to that one language only -- for a defect in one language's
own codegen stage while the same example generates fine in every other registered language
(a distinction that could not exist before the language sweep made every example genuinely
All entries reproduce with the sanctioned generator (generate.ps1 <system.dtrx> <out> -L <language>),
so none is a gate artifact.
expected_count is a pinned, reviewed value: change it only in the same change that adds or
removes an entry. Removing an entry means the defect is FIXED and the example must be blessed.

examples.02-features-02-service-architecture-pubs: ConfigResolutionError ING001: the system declares a gateway {} block but no service derives ServiceIngressExposure.GATEWAY (a front door with nothing behind it). Example-definition defect: the example declares no external-caller auth(...) endpoint. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-REPLAYABLE-INGESTION-ING001.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-con: ValueError from build_runtime_bootstrap: RuntimeBootstrap LOCAL requires config_store engine 'file' (platform 'container'), but the example declares engine='consul' platform='container'. The example's declared config store is incompatible with the LOCAL runtime-bootstrap contract. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-CONFIG-STORE-CONSUL-BOOTSTRAP.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-nos: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes AND the entity-to-Response-DTO return mapping fix landed): mvnw compile fails on 3 services for defects OUTSIDE both those fixes. library_book_service: a DSL Array.filter(lambda) call on a query result transpiles to a literal '.filter(...)' call on java.util.List (needs Stream API lowering); the API-level fn 'findBooksByFilter' (-> Array<bookDb.Book>) declared-type resolution is tracked separately. library_loan_service: the cross-service internal-API call syntax (ServiceName.APIName.verb.endpoint(...)) never wires its target service as a constructor-injected client -- datrix-codegen-java's own TranspileContext.service_name_map (the slot python's plugin.py populates for exactly this) is declared but never populated for java (grep-confirmed: two definition sites, zero real writers/readers); same gap also leaves DateTime.addDays(...) untranslated and drops an unrelated logger field. library_member_service: MemberProfile (a struct) built from a raw Map, and a Member->MemberResponse generic-bounds mismatch. datrix-codegen-java gaps; out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CROSS-SERVICE-CLIENT-INJECTION.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-cac: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes AND the entity-to-Response-DTO return mapping fix landed): mvnw compile still fails on the SAME cross-service internal-API client injection gap as nosql::java (service_name_map never populated for java) in LoanAPIController/MemberAPIController, plus DateTime.addDays(...) emitted untranslated. datrix-codegen-java gap; out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CROSS-SERVICE-CLIENT-INJECTION.
examples.02-features-02-service-architecture-pubs: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes AND the entity-to-Response-DTO return mapping fix landed): mvnw compile still fails on 2 services for defects OUTSIDE both those fixes. library_book_service: the Book entity's own computed-field methods fail to compile independently of any controller -- an Array<String> field's DSL methods (.length(), .join(', ')) transpile to java.util.List<String> method calls that do not exist (needs .size()/String.join(', ', list)), a String[]-vs-List<String> field-init mismatch, and Math.round(a_BigDecimal_field, precision) has no matching java.lang.Math overload (needs BigDecimal-aware rounding). library_member_service: MemberProfile built from a raw Map, plus the Member->MemberResponse generic-bounds mismatch (same as nosql::java's member service). datrix-codegen-java gaps (computed-field collection/BigDecimal builtin translation, struct construction); out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-COMPUTED-FIELD-COLLECTION-METHODS.
